metric: Implied public-disclosure facility availability gap versus gross unused stated capacity

what_it_does_not_say: It does not split which facility provided the availability.

what_it_says: Cash was a small share of disclosed liquidity.

what_it_does_not_say: The actual defined threshold can depend on agreement definitions and specified availability calculation.
